author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to build an app with Microsoft Copilot without writing a single line of code. For this video, I used Microsoft Copilot Code in Frontier. In this step-by-step Copilot Code tutorial, we'll turn an Excel spreadsheet into an interactive order management app for the Kevin Cookie Company. You'll learn how to create a sales dashboard, filter customer orders, add and edit orders, and publish and share your app with colleagues.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
Sponsored by: Microsoft
